apiTokenHelp: Starts with abrk_. It belongs to exactly one client and is shown only once when it is created; a new one can be created and the old one revoked at any time.
feedinTableHelp: If a feed-in meter exists, the self-consumption is production minus feed-in. Without it, the smaller of production and total consumption is used.
flowConsumption: Consumption of the building per day in kWh
flowCountersNote: The source "Counters" has no Solar-Log mapping: the daily values come from the meter readings in the tables on the Counters tab (difference between two daily closings at 23:58).
flowFeedin: Feed-in in kWh: exact when the day was integrated over the day; otherwise production minus consumption (at least 0)
flowIntro: Which data points of the Solar-Log adapter (solarlog.0) are delivered to the billing server as which values. Daily values are delivered: the current day as a provisional state (every 15 minutes, computed by the solarlog adapter including the split into solar and grid power); at 23:58 the day is closed and replaces the provisional state. In addition the adapter asks the server every 10 minutes as a sign of life and delivers missing days afterwards.
flowMethod: Calculation method: "integriert" (integrated) when the polls cover at least 95% of the day, otherwise "tagesnetto" (approximation)
flowProduction: Production per day in kWh: daily yield of all inverters
flowQuality: Data quality: "veraltet" (outdated) when the last Solar-Log poll is more than 30 minutes old
flowSplit: Split of each unit's consumption into solar power and grid draw (from the integration over the day, otherwise daily net approximation)
flowTariffs: Tariffs are not delivered: the server provides them and the adapter takes them from there.
flowUnitConsumption: Consumption per unit in kWh: daily sum of the meter. <name> is the name of the unit (rename or skip it in the table on the Source tab)
flowUnitMeter: Meter reading per unit: running reading, maintained by the Solar-Log adapter
hintConnectionText: The adapter delivers the daily figures to the Abrechnung Mailcarrier web application over HTTPS. Server and token come from the Administration area of the web application (Clients, tab Access).
hostHelp: Host name only, e.g. abr.mailcarrier.ch. The connection is always encrypted (HTTPS).
hostInvalid: Enter only the host name, without path (e.g. abr.mailcarrier.ch).
journalStateIdHelp: State of the solarlog adapter with the daily journal (default solarlog.0.Database.dailyJournal). One entry per day with the daily values; the current day is updated provisionally every 15 minutes and closed at night.
metersTableHelp: One row per apartment: the name as it appears in the billing (e.g. WHG 1) and the energy state of its meter.
productionTableHelp: Energy states of the production of all inverters. They are added up.
snapshotTimeHelp: Time of day when the readings are taken and the day is closed (default 23:58).
snapshotTimeInvalid: Please enter a time as HH:MM.
sourceCounters: Energy states of other adapters (e.g. Shelly, inverter)
sourceType: Where do the figures come from?
sourceTypeHelp: iobroker.solarlog computes the split itself and keeps a local journal. With energy states the split is computed here from counters of other adapters.
staleMinutesHelp: A reading older than this at day closing marks the day as outdated.
unitMapTableHelp: Only needed if a unit of the solarlog journal must be called differently in the billing, or must not be delivered at all.
